tags.name: Pets allowed only in outdoor dining areas (patio/terrace)

bio: Would you like to immerse yourself in the beauty and essence of the Alentejo? At Quinta do Quetzal, art, wine and gastronomy come together in a stunning setting, amid the golden hills and the tranquillity of Vidigueira. The offering led by chef João Mourato is presented in two tasting menus (7 or 9 courses) or à la carte and celebrates traditional Alentejo flavours with a contemporary touch grounded in regional ingredients. The River crayfish à Bulhão Pato (garlic–cilantro dressing) served with low-temperature egg and cured pork belly, and the dessert Delírio de Vila de Frades (a convent-sweets homage with modern presentation), are among the dishes that deserve to be highlighted. To round off the experience, you may include a visit to the adega (winery), the cave (cellar), the art gallery… or a stroll through the vineyards!
